content:
I can read most widely used languages—well over 50—with strongest performance in about 20–30 of them.

Strong coverage includes:
- English and most major European languages (e.g., Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Turkish, Greek, the Nordics, etc.)
- Major Middle Eastern and South Asian languages (e.g., Arabic, Persian, Hebrew, Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Punjabi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam)
- East and Southeast Asian languages (e.g., Chinese—Simplified/Traditional, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, Filipino)

I can also read many others to varying degrees. If you tell me the language or share a sample, I’ll let you know how well I can handle it.
